title: VoiceCommand
description: What the deterministic voice grammar (P2, es/en) understood. Same output from the web parser and the runner parser (shared fixtures). Never written anywhere by itself: the app shows a confirmation card first (invariant 8). Dates are local calendar values, resolved against the reference day the parser was given.

quest.description: complete / snooze / defer: how the user named the quest (matched in code).

date.description: create: the day to schedule; defer: the new day.

time.description: create: local time of day, when one was said.

minutes.description: snooze: how long, when one was said.
